pages.title: Why a telescope
pages.text: Even with a rocket you cannot fly to a body you have not researched. Unlock it first, and that includes the $(l:space/planets/moon)Moon$(). A planet's moons unlock together with it.

pages.title: Research steps
pages.text: $(li)Power the telescope and aim it at the target.$(li)Keep the target in view until data collection ends.$(li)Place the Mission Control Station right next to the telescope.$(li)Put a launch pad next to it.

pages.title: Launching a mission
pages.text: $(li)Place a satellite rocket on the pad.$(li)Fuel it.$(li)Choose the mission at the station and start it.$(li)Wait a few minutes.$(li)Press the analyze button and the planet is unlocked.

pages.title: Mission setup
pages.text: Telescope, control station and a pad with a rocket.

pages.title: Station screen
pages.text: Choose missions and start the analysis here.

pages.title: Deep space
pages.text: For other stars the mission asks for more: at least 3 finished missions and a Teledish antenna linked with a Frequency Module. Other stars cannot be seen from Earth: look for Proxima B with a telescope on Pluto, Haumea or the Kuiper Belt, and for Tau Ceti F from Proxima B.

pages.title: Asteroid mining
pages.text: Asteroids sometimes approach the planet. Find one with the telescope and start a mission with a mining rocket. It returns to the same pad with a load of ores and gems.

pages.title: Good to know
pages.text: A $(l:space/tech/space_station)space station$() helps find villages, mansions and boss dungeons within 1000 blocks: choose this at the control station. Research Paper moves finished missions between stations.

pages.title: Telescope
pages.text: Collects the first data about a celestial body.

pages.title: Mission Control Station
pages.text: Starts missions and analyzes their results.

pages.title: Satellite Rocket
pages.text: Flies without a crew. A planet will not unlock without it.

pages.title: Mining Rocket
pages.text: Mines ore from asteroids and comes back.

pages.title: Research Paper
pages.text: Moves a finished mission to another station.
